$schema-note: Descriptions for structural props whose meaning is identical on every family that declares them. Applied by scripts/component-props-lib.mjs only when the source has no JSDoc for that prop — JSDoc always wins, so a family can say something more specific. The anchored-overlay positioning props are included because select, dropdown-menu, popover, tooltip and the date pickers all re-declare one contract that resolves in the same `packages/core/src/utils/anchored-overlay.ts` kernel. Props whose meaning varies by component (`value`, `disabled`, `loading`, `invalid`, `onValueChange`, `defaultValue`, `direction`) are deliberately absent: a shared sentence there would be a plausible generalisation rather than a fact, which is the error class the behavior-prose guard already caught five times.

props.children: Content rendered inside this element. The family's composition section states which children it expects.
props.className: Extra utility classes, merged after the component's own via `cn(...)`, so they win on conflict. An escape hatch for source-owned and application work, not a cross-engine portability guarantee.
props.description: Secondary supporting text rendered beneath the primary label or title.
props.label: The visible text naming this element, and the accessible name unless one is set explicitly.
props.labelClassName: Extra utility classes for the label text specifically, merged after the component's own.
props.testID: Test identifier. Forwarded to the native `testID` and, on Web, emitted as `data-testid`.
props.title: The primary heading text for this surface.
props.trailing: Content rendered at the end of the row, after the primary content — actions, badges or status.
props.align: Where the overlay sits along the anchor's cross axis — `'start'`, `'center'` or `'end'`. The anchored-overlay kernel may flip it when the preferred placement would collide with the viewport.
props.alignOffset: Pixels to shift the overlay along the alignment axis, after `align` is resolved.
props.sideOffset: Pixels of gap between the anchor and the overlay, along the placement side.
props.collisionPadding: Minimum distance to keep from the viewport edges when the kernel repositions or flips the overlay. A number applies to every edge; an object sets edges individually.
props.avoidKeyboard: Whether the overlay repositions to stay clear of the on-screen keyboard.
props.avoidSafeArea: Whether the overlay keeps clear of the platform safe-area insets — notches, home indicators and status bars.
props.closeOnOutsidePress: Whether a press outside the overlay dismisses it.
props.containerClassName: Extra utility classes for the overlay's container element, merged after the component's own.
props.overlayClassName: Extra utility classes for the backdrop element behind the surface, merged after the component's own.
